records.title: H37: Using alt attributes on img elements
records.summary: Meaningful img elements need a short text alternative that conveys the same purpose; important words shown in the image belong in the alternative.
records.repair_summary: Add an alt attribute whose value is derived from independently verified image purpose; decorative images use an empty alt value.

provenance.title: H37: Using alt attributes on img elements

records.title: F65: Omitted text alternative
records.summary: An img, area, or image input without an alt attribute or other text alternative can fail Non-text Content.
records.repair_summary: Classify the image purpose before adding an appropriate alt value; do not infer contextual meaning from a filename alone.

provenance.title: F65: Failure due to omitting the alt attribute or text alternative

records.title: H44: Associate text labels with form controls
records.summary: A label element can explicitly associate visible label text with an input, textarea, or select through matching for and id values.
records.repair_summary: Create a stable unique control id and bind a visible label using label[for]; preserve existing accessible-name precedence.

provenance.title: H44: Using label elements to associate text labels with form controls

records.title: F68: Control lacks a programmatically determined name
records.summary: A user-interface control can fail Name, Role, Value when assistive technologies cannot determine its name.
records.repair_summary: Prefer an explicit visible label for form controls; use another accessible-name mechanism only when its semantics and precedence are verified.

provenance.title: F68: UI control without a programmatically determined name

records.title: G91: Provide link text that describes link purpose
records.summary: Descriptive link text helps a user distinguish a link and determine whether to follow it; a destination URI alone is generally insufficient.
records.repair_summary: Use visible link text that communicates destination or action; contextual alternatives require human verification of surrounding programmatic context.

provenance.title: G91: Providing link text that describes the purpose of a link

records.title: H78: Determine link purpose from its enclosing paragraph
records.summary: A link's purpose can sometimes be determined from link text together with its programmatically associated enclosing paragraph.
records.repair_summary: Prefer self-descriptive text; when relying on context, preserve a programmatically determinable relationship and require contextual review.

provenance.title: H78: Identifying link purpose using its enclosing paragraph

records.title: H57: Use the language attribute on the HTML element
records.summary: The html lang attribute identifies the document's default language and should use a valid tag reflecting the page's primary language.
records.repair_summary: Set html[lang] to a verified BCP 47 language tag matching the page's primary language.

provenance.title: H57: Using the language attribute on the HTML element

records.title: G18: Ensure at least 4.5:1 contrast for regular text
records.summary: Regular text and images of text should have at least 4.5:1 contrast against the rendered background, subject to WCAG exceptions and large-text thresholds.
records.repair_summary: Adjust a bounded foreground or background colour token only after computing the effective rendered colours, font threshold, states, and applicable exceptions.

provenance.title: G18: Ensuring a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

records.title: F83: Insufficient contrast over background images
records.summary: Text can fail contrast requirements when a background image causes insufficient foreground-to-background contrast.
records.repair_summary: Measure worst-case effective background pixels before changing colour, overlay, or background treatment; preserve content and brand constraints for review.

provenance.title: F83: Insufficient contrast with background images
